A learner of Spanish is rewriting part of a post. The sentence they are working towards, for you only (never quote it or give it away): "Quedo a la espera de sus noticias.". Gloss each hint word in the sense it has in that sentence, not its most common sense ("alone" in "the clouds alone explain it" means "only", not "by oneself").

Their hint words, exactly 4: "espera", "noticias", "ilusión", "pendiente". "a / b" is a choice between two words.

For each of these hint words and no others, in this order: piece: the hint word as given. gloss: in English, what it means here and how it is used, in one or two short sentences (the kind of word, what it goes with, register if it matters; for a choice, how the two differ). example: one short, natural Spanish sentence that uses it in the same sense, about everyday life and on a topic unrelated to the post (different people, events and subject), so it shows the word without giving away the sentence they are building.
Reply with JSON only: {"notes":[{"piece":"","gloss":"","example":""}]}

result.text: {"notes":[{"piece":"espera","gloss":"Feminine noun meaning 'wait' or 'waiting period'. Here it appears in the fixed phrase 'a la espera de', meaning 'awaiting' or 'waiting for' something expected, a neutral, standard register.","example":"Tuvimos una larga espera en la consulta del médico."},{"piece":"noticias","gloss":"Plural noun meaning 'news' or 'word' about someone. Here it means information or a message from the other person, and it is used with 'tener noticias de' or 'sus noticias' in a polite, formal register.","example":"Hace meses que no tengo noticias de mi hermana."},{"piece":"ilusión","gloss":"Feminine noun meaning 'hope', 'excitement', or 'eager anticipation' about something you look forward to. It does not appear in this target sentence, so it is not part of the sense being built there.","example":"Tengo mucha ilusión por el viaje de verano con mis amigos."},{"piece":"pendiente","gloss":"Adjective meaning 'pending', 'outstanding', or 'not yet settled'. It does not appear in this target sentence, so it is not part of the sense being built there (as a noun it can also mean 'earring').","example":"Todavía tengo pendiente pagar la factura de la luz."}]}
